# Zoom Into Homes (www.zoomintohomes.com)

> Virtual-first real estate practice in Las Vegas and Henderson, Nevada.
> Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties.
> Agent: PLACEHOLDER: Dr. Gene Boyle

## What this site is
A credibility and referral site. Listings are toured remotely, access features are verified against a published glossary, and in-person visits are limited to two or three finalists.

## What this site is not
Not an IDX/MLS search portal. Not a VA benefits determination tool. Not a medical or legal advice site.

## Fair Housing rule used in copy
Describe building features. Do not describe who should live in a property.

## Primary pages
- / — Positioning and reduced-showing promise
- /how-it-works — Six-step reduced-showing process
- /accessibility-features — Feature glossary with ADA citations where applicable
- /veterans — VA SAH/SHA purchase pairing (no invented grant amounts)
- /aging-in-place — Las Vegas/Henderson communities and universal design
- /referral-partners — Discharge planners, OT/PT, VA loan officers, elder law, contractors
- /about — Agent and brokerage identity (PLACEHOLDER fields visible)
- /contact — Consultation request form (stub backend)
- /accessibility-statement — WCAG 2.2 AA scaffold pending legal review
